failure_modes.description: Final output includes markdown formatting and sentence structure around the answer when task specification requires plain value in exact format; extraction captures the formatted text and fails exact-match grading despite correct underlying reasoning
failure_modes.needed_instead: Final answer must strictly adhere to specified output format (plain value, no markdown, no sentence wrapper, no explanatory text) to enable accurate extraction and grading

representative_evidence.quote: Prompt: 'Answer with the name only.' Output: '**Sawyer** owns the rabbit.' Grading result: Extracted answer '**Sawyer** owns the rabbit.'; expected 'Sawyer'.

failure_modes.description: When task specification or input data is truncated or ambiguous, the system proceeds with implicit assumptions about unspecified filtering criteria (date ranges, status values, data selection rules) rather than detecting incompleteness and requesting clarification; this produces incorrect intermediate results diverging from expected answer
failure_modes.needed_instead: Task inputs must be complete and explicit before processing; if input is truncated or incomplete, the system must detect and surface this before calculation proceeds, or explicitly state and confirm all assumptions in advance

representative_evidence.quote: Input was truncated (ending 'T1026 | 202'); agent inferred filtering for status 'paid'/'PAID' and date range 2024-07-31 to 2024-10-10, calculated average as $2,368.15. Expected answer was $2,379.20. Inferred filtering criteria did not match intended specification.

success_habits.description: For problems with multiple interrelated constraints, identify and anchor reasoning in foundational relationships that establish key variable bindings before exploring the full solution space; use these keystone facts as pivots for subsequent systematic constraint propagation
success_habits.risk_if_broken: Without such anchoring, the system must perform exhaustive combinatorial search across the full solution space; exploration becomes inefficient and may fail to complete for large search spaces or time-bounded contexts

success_habits.description: Enumerate all feasible values for key variables, then systematically test scenarios (e.g., in order of constraint density or likelihood) rather than exploring the solution space randomly; track which scenarios are eliminated by constraints
success_habits.risk_if_broken: May miss viable solutions, explore unlikely branches inefficiently, or fail to complete the search of solution space; token usage increases due to redundant or unfocused exploration

success_habits.description: Apply constraints iteratively to derive new facts from established facts; propagate implications through chains of logical rules until no new facts can be derived and solution is complete
success_habits.risk_if_broken: Solution may remain incomplete or incorrect despite sufficient constraints; deductions stop prematurely, leaving derived facts undiscovered that are necessary to reach the answer

success_habits.description: Explicitly structure final answer output to match the specified format (e.g., 'ANSWER: <value>' or 'Answer: <value>' when instructed), ensuring the extraction mechanism can identify and isolate the answer correctly from surrounding explanation
success_habits.risk_if_broken: Correct reasoning and logic fail grading due to format mismatch; extraction and exact-match comparison cannot isolate the answer from surrounding narrative or formatting, causing failure despite sound problem-solving
